newsitem.title: USA: Four dead in Tennessee fireworks warehouse blast.
newsitem.headline: Four dead in Tennessee fireworks warehouse blast.

text.p: Four people were killed and a number of others injured on Thursday when a fireworks factory warehouse exploded, scattering live shells for blocks and causing widespread damage, officials said.
Clifford Jennings, mayor of the town of about 9,000, said two men and two women were confirmed dead.
His brother Victor, who works at WQLA Radio in La Follette, said, "It was a major explosion. The windows in a car dealership a mile and a half away were blown out.

"A church across the street was damaged and a man who was in the basement was blown out the back door, but not injured," he told Reuters. "There are hundreds of live shells strewn about. The fire department is trying to wet them down."

The warehouse on the edge of town belonged to Pyro Shows Inc., which calls itself "an international leader in the pyrotechnic field." It put on the 1995 Fourth of July fireworks show in Washington, D.C.
